definitionZh: :host CSS伪类选择包含它内部使用的CSS的阴影DOM的阴影主机——换句话说,这允许您从它的阴影DOM内部选择自定义元素.
sourceDefinition: The :host CSS pseudo-class selects the shadow host of the shadow DOM containing the CSS it is used inside — in other words, this allows you to select a custom element from inside its shadow DOM.
